study: Stack verification: the same daily proposals on images built from two commits, on the VM rehearsal through the public API
stack: deploy/vm rehearsal (proxy, booking and daily pools, VM compute caps; the development routing service capped to the VM partition), shipped routing and admission defaults, embedded calculation
protocol: Step 1: 1 planner, synchronous, fleets 50 technicians x 3 visits, points seeds 1, 2, 3, 4 proposals each. Search 10 s cost + 5 s fairness, TABU_KOPT, fairness budget 0.02. Roads cold at each run's start, never warmed. Order: step 1 in before and after pairs per fleet and seed, the pair order alternating; no step 2. Daily pool with SCHEDULER_STUDY_RECEIPTS=true and TIMEFOLD_LOG_LEVEL=INFO; the kit reads each receipt and pairs it with its request's Timefold phase speeds. Every phase of every proposal flight-recorded on the JDK profile configuration (SCHEDULER_STUDY_PROFILES); the profiles block attributes each calculation thread's samples.
